title_zh: 向工厂索取小批量制作报价

scenario.label_zh: 询问小批量制造及人工费用
scenario.goal_zh: 确认工厂可做小批量产品，并约定提供尺寸后分别报价材料与人工

context_zh: 虚构美国工厂参观中，创作者罗莎询问生产主管迪恩能否制作少量展示架。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Do you manufacture these stands here, or do you bring them in from another company?

sentences.speaker: Dean
sentences.text: We make the frames here. The wooden shelves come from a local supplier.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I only need twelve. Is your manufacturing process set up for orders that small?

sentences.speaker: Dean
sentences.text: We can do twelve, but the labor cost per stand will be higher than for a large order.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I see. The catalogue price is based on mass production, then?

sentences.speaker: Dean
sentences.text: Yes, several hundred identical units. Your order would involve a separate setup.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Please quote for twelve and show materials and labor separately. I'll send the exact dimensions this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Dean
sentences.text: Once those arrive, I'll prepare the quote. We won't start making anything until you've approved it.

targets.sense_zh: 生产中所需的人工劳动
